name: icecream-tracker
description: Ice cream debt tracker API (Cloudflare Worker + D1)

scripts.db:init: wrangler d1 execute icecream --local --file schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute icecream --local --file seed.sql
scripts.db:reset: wrangler d1 execute icecream --local --command "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS events; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS shops; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS milestones; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS settings; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pin_attempts;" && npm run db:init
